description: This Java source file defines the Mqtt3Validator class, which extends AbstractMqttValidator and provides validation logic specific to MQTT 3.1.1 protocol connections within an Eclipse Ditto service. It includes methods for validating connection properties such as URI schemes, client counts, addresses, source and target configurations, and payload mappings.

classes.name: Mqtt3Validator
classes.description: A validator class for MQTT 3.1.1 protocol connections, ensuring configurations adhere to protocol-specific constraints and standards.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of Mqtt3Validator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is MQTT.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of a connection object, headers, and actor system for MQTT 3.1.1 compliance.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration for MQTT 3.1.1, ensuring header mapping is not used and consumer count is within limits.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration for MQTT 3.1.1, ensuring header mapping is not used.
